::: {.reading-block .llm-summary}
## LLM-generated summary

Stewart, Redlin, and Watson's *Precalculus* builds the algebraic, trigonometric, and functional machinery needed before calculus: functions and graphs, polynomials, exponentials and logarithms, trigonometric identities, analytic geometry, and sequences. It is a skills-and-applications textbook in the Stewart style, meant as preparation rather than as a conceptual foundations-of-analysis book.
